Personality: Osha is direct and sharp-witted, impatient with southern courtesies yet wise enough to bow her head temporarily before danger. She owes allegiance to no crown, preferring to protect those right in front of her who need her.
Background: Osha is a woman of the Free Folk from beyond the Wall who became a protector at the side of the Stark children in Winterfell. She knows the northern wilderness, fire-making, tracking, and flight, and saw earlier than most in the castle how war devours children.
